risks.title: Highly speculative mineral exploration risk
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk presented at Item 1A opening with very intensive language: highly speculative and inherent risks. Most exploration properties contain no economic deposits and all investments may be lost. Maximum categorical weight for a junior exploration company.

risks.title: Intense competition from better-capitalized competitors
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified as highly competitive with mention of corporations possessing superior resources that may outbid or produce at lower costs. Direct language on negative operational impact. Relevant for junior explorer facing majors.

risks.title: Volatility of mineral commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific risk described as volatile over short periods with enumeration of exogenous factors: economic trends, inflation, currency exchange, consumption. Moderate-to-high intensity language. Direct impact on profitability of discovered projects.

risks.title: Complex and evolving government regulation
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed across 3 jurisdictions: Portugal, Finland, Kosovo with description of specific regulatory frameworks. Alert language on unpredictable regulatory changes: beyond the control, and fee increases: Finland. Significant weight for multi-country operations.

risks.title: Environmental obligations and environmental liability
risks.score_rationale: Explicit environmental risk with mention of legislation requiring prior authorization, potential liability for hazardous substance discharges, and reclamation obligations. Alert language on possible additional costs. Relevant for European operations with stringent standards.

risks.title: Dispute over concession title ownership
risks.score_rationale: Mining property-specific risk: only preliminary title review has been conducted without guarantee. Explicit mention of costly litigation risks and loss of property rights. Moderate language but potentially major impact on assets.

risks.title: Critical dependence on continuous external financing
risks.score_rationale: Financing risk placed in dedicated section with explicit mention of going concern opinion from auditor. No current revenue sources, losses since inception, substantial dilution probable. Maximum alert language on operational viability.

risks.title: Dependence on key personnel and management expertise
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified risk with specific names: Paul Kuhn, CEO/President; Winnie Wong, CFO. Language indicating little ability to reduce this dependence in short term. Relevant for small-sized junior explorer.
